title: Support.
officialText:
Light-transmitting plastic diffusers shall be supported directly or indirectly from ceiling or roof construction by
use of noncombustible hangers. Hangers shall be at least No. 12 steel-wire gage (0.106 inch) galvanized wire or equivalent.
Exception: Light-transmitting plastic diffusers used in suspended acoustical ceiling systems shall conform with the support
requirements as set forth in Section 803.9.
